name: Retraining programme
description: Adds a retraining programme on top of cohort-flow.json: a participation input, a parameter for how much participation raises the monthly re-employment rate, a multiplicative effect on reemploymentRate, and a new cost variable (participants x cost per participant). Neither of cohort-flow's equations is rewritten.

source.label: illustrative ramp-up of programme participation among the displaced pool
author guess: full participation raises the re-employment rate by 50%

variables.description: Members of the displaced pool enrolled in retraining this month

source.label: author guess: participation scales the re-employment rate up

tests.name: retraining cost tracks enrolled participants at full ramp
